entries.title: Etymologisches Wörterbuch des Deutschen (EtymWB), Wolfgang Pfeifer project

institutions: Berlin-Brandenburgische Akademie der Wissenschaften, Zentrum Sprache

dating.original_or_coverage_date: developed in the 1980s; first and second print editions 1989 and 1993
dating.edition_or_version: digital version based on the second 1993 edition, updated by Wolfgang Pfeifer through 2020; over 23000 lexemes, over 9000 main entries, and over 14000 subentries

entries.scholarly_posture: institutionally maintained etymological reference candidate; every etymological statement still needs exact article citation and competing-source review
limits: etymological reconstruction is not semantic intention
model paraphrase of an entry is not evidence
no etymology is accepted from one source
current DWDS terms do not authorize an unrestricted automated or bulk-content route
the exact headword URL and access date must be recorded per finding

citation_requirements: cite the headword, Wolfgang Pfeifer et al., the 1993 resource basis, exact EtymWB URL, and access date using the official DWDS guidance

blocking_reasons: no headword packet has been selected
a second etymological source is required for every accepted finding or disagreement must remain unresolved
automated access requires express permission or a documented legal basis

entries.notes: Use exact routes such as https://www.dwds.de/wb/etymwb/Wort for point consultation. Wörterbuchnetz configures EtymWb as a remote DWDS resource; its failed API route is not a backend contract.
